newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bourse adjusts stock weightings in Mib30.
newsitem.headline: Italy bourse adjusts stock weightings in Mib30.

text.p: The Italian bourse council has adjusted the weighting of some of the shares in the Milan stock market's Mib30 of top Italian company shares following changes to the blue-chip index on Wednesday.

Among the major shares, the weighting of energy giant ENI rose to 21.7 percent from 19.3 percent, Telecom Italia increased to 8.1 percent from 6.6 percent, while mobile phone group Telecom Italia Mobile rose to 8.1 percent from 7.4 percent.

The weighting for some was reduced, with insurer Generali down to 10.4 percent from 12.6 percent, automotive and industrial group Fiat down to 5.2 percent from 7.0 percent and information technology group Olivetti down to 0.7 percent from 1.9 percent.

There were four new entrants to the MIB30 on Wednesday: TV and advertising group Mediaset, insurer Mediolanum Banca Fideuram and engineering group Saipem. Out of the Mib30 went Compart (formerly Ferruzzi), Ambroveneto, IFIL and IFI.
